# Healthy Socks

> Healthy Socks creates sustainable, medical-themed compression socks for healthcare professionals with a mission to support Doctors Without Borders.

Healthy Socks specializes in eco-friendly medical apparel designed specifically for healthcare workers across all specialties. Each purchase supports charitable causes through their partnership with Doctors Without Borders (MSF), combining comfort, sustainability, and social impact.

## Key Topics

- Medical-themed socks
- Compression socks
- Healthcare professionals
- Doctors Without Borders
- Sustainable apparel
- Nurse socks
- IV Socks

- Healthcare workers
- Specialty socks

## Getting Started

- [Healthy Socks | Sustainable Comfort, Shared Impact](https://www.healthysocks.com): Homepage showcasing eco-friendly medical socks with charity partnership
- [About Us](https://www.healthysocks.com/pages/about-us): Company story and mission featuring Doctors Without Borders partnership
- [Best Sellers](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/best-verkocht): Best-selling medical-themed socks including Uterus and IV Socks

## Medical Specialty Collections

- [Nursing](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/nursing): Nursing collection with Bandage and Blood Collection Tubes Socks
- [Cardiology](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/cardiology): Cardiology-themed socks including Cardiosocks and Blood Collection Tubes
- [Emergency Medicine (ER)](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/emergency-medicine-er): Emergency room socks featuring Ambulance and Bandage Socks
- [Intensive Care Unit (ICU)](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/intensive-care-unit-icu): ICU socks collection with Bandage and Cardiosocks for intensive care
- [Laboratory & Pathology](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/laboratory-pathology): Lab-themed socks including DNA and Microscope designs
- [Gynecology](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/gynecology): Gynecology socks including Uterus and IV Socks designs
- [Pediatrics](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/pediatrics): Pediatrics-themed medical socks for children's healthcare workers

## Clinical Specialties

- [Anesthesiology](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/anesthesiology): Medical-themed socks collection for anesthesiology professionals
- [Neurology](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/neurology): Neurology socks featuring Syringe and X-Ray themed designs
- [Internal Medicine](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/internal-medicine): Internal medicine socks featuring Blood Collection Tubes and Cardiosocks
- [ENT (Ear, Nose & Throat)](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/ent-ear-nose-throat): ENT and Face Mask Socks collection for ear, nose, throat specialists
- [Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/physical-medicine-rehabilitation): Rehabilitation-themed socks for physical medicine professionals

## Care Settings & Services

- [Ambulance Services](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/ambulance-services): Ambulance and Bandage Socks collection for emergency services
- [Geriatrics (Elderly Care)](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/geriatrics-elderly-care): Geriatrics collection featuring Cardiosocks for elderly care
- [Diabetes Care](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/diabetes-care): Compression socks collection for diabetes care professionals
- [Midwifery & Maternity Care](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/midwifery-maternity-care): Maternity and midwifery socks collection for pregnancy professionals
- [General Practice](https://www.healthysocks.com/collections/general-practice): General practice medical socks with Ambulance and Bandage designs
